title: AI-Native Product Management: A Vision
abstract: arXiv:2610.14823v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Artificial intelligence is increasingly used to support product management tasks. At the same time, AI-native research and development (R&D) may increase software realization capacity. Organizations may realize software faster than they can identify, qualify, and reconsider what should be realized. This paper asks how product management should be re-envisioned under these conditions. We synthesize research on software product management, product learning, human-AI collaboration, and the Product Management and R&D boundary. We propose a vision in which AI becomes a persistent participant in product work. The vision covers sensing, exploration, decision-making, realization, and learning. We propose six principles and make the vision tangible through an operating model grounded in human professionals, AI personas, agents, skills, and a shared product context. translated_title: AI原生产品管理：一个愿景
translated_abstract: 人工智能正被越来越多地用于支持产品管理任务。与此同时，AI原生的研发（R&D）可能会提升软件实现能力。组织实现软件的速度可能会超过其识别、评估和重新审视哪些内容应该被实现的速度。本文探讨在这些条件下应如何重新构想产品管理。我们综合了软件产品管理、产品学习、人机协作以及产品管理与研发边界等方面的研究。我们提出了一个愿景：AI成为产品工作中的持续性参与者。该愿景涵盖感知、探索、决策、实现和学习五个方面。我们提出了六项原则，并通过一个基于人类专业人员、AI角色、智能体、技能和共享产品上下文的运营模型使这一愿景具体化。我们进一步论证，AI原生产品管理与AI原生研发可以形成一个……
tldr: 该论文提出了AI原生产品管理的愿景，主张让AI作为产品工作的持续参与者贯穿感知、探索、决策、实现和学习全过程，并通过六项原则以及基于人类专业人员、AI角色、智能体、技能和共享产品上下文的运营模型将愿景落地。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a vision for AI-native Product Management in which AI becomes a persistent participant in product work across sensing, exploration, decision-making, realization, and learning, made tangible through six principles and an operating model grounded in human professionals, AI personas, agents, skills, and a shared product context.
